page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters on this scan are faint and were copied as best read; doubtful Hebrew forms (e.g. the entry "וַיִּשְׁנָא", the Hebrew in "שְׁנָאָן" and "שִׂנְאָת") may differ in points. "Jef." is printed as such for Jer. The Hebrew catchword "שנה" and the running head are reproduced from the scan. Stray marks (dots, a dark blob near the centre of the left column, a small tick at the right edge) are not printed text and are omitted.
